name: Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn Jarīr al-Ṭabarī
title: scholar

key_actions.summary: Begins Jāmiʿ al-bayān ʿan taʾwīl āy al-Qurʾān, a verse-by-verse Qur'anic exegesis collecting earlier traditions.
Completes Taʾrīkh al-rusul wa-l-mulūk (History of the Prophets and Kings) — the most extensive Arabic universal history of the medieval period, from creation through 915 CE.
Dies at Baghdad. The Taʾrīkh becomes the single most-cited source for Umayyad and early Abbasid history.
